**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/053_S3.7__model-plane-eval.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.3.1, R-2.3.2⁰, R-2.3.3⁰, R-2.3.4⁰ (S3

## Summary

**Drift probes and the substitution gate execute.** `hh-gateway::probes`
runs the transport-declaration probes (`probe_capability` port method —
default `UnsupportedFeature`, never fabricated), the fingerprint probe
(honest `unknown` when unobservable), and discovery conformance, issuing
`ConformanceRecord` rows and `SnapshotClaim`s on substitution/fingerprint
drift — probe/discovery calls charge `instrument`. The gateway refuses a
disallowed served-model substitution with a terminal
`model.call.failed{served_model_mismatch}` (the sequence stays canonical);
an allowed substitution completes stamped `served_model`/`substitution`
and `charge_model` keys the charge at the served coordinate.

**Hosted normalization is a stamp, not a second sequence.**
`stamp_participant` folds `participant_class` into every emitted
`model.call.*` row — request, the interleaved attempt/delta stream, and
the terminal — so a hosted call's canonical sequence is byte-identical in
shape to a native one (AC-R-2.3.1-15).

**Accounting completeness is a typed-violation fold in `hh-eval`.**
`facts.rs` projects the durable rows into `LedgerFacts`;
`accounting::model_accounting` returns a closed `AccountingViolation`
sum: exactly one `model_calls` charge per terminal, one attempt span per
`(call, attempt)`, probe/discovery charged `instrument`, charge
`attribution.model_ref` = latest route decision. A cache-served terminal
must show `model.cache.resolved`, a zero-amount charge with
`cache_hit = true`, `timing = n/a{not_run}`, and avoided estimates carry
`provenance = estimated_from_pricing`.

**Deviation and outage postures are pre-registered `Design` members.**
`routing_policy` (`fail_fast` default), `deviation_policy ∈
{exclude_deviated, stratify, pool_with_flag}`, `cache_na_stratified` —
additive with decode defaults (CC8). `compare` refuses mixed
deviated/clean pooling without a declared policy
(`UnstratifiedDeviation`), refuses `replayed_trajectory` runs outright
(`ReplayedTrajectory`), and refuses a deviation under `fail_fast`
(`DeviationUnderFailFast`); `stratify` yields per-stratum outcomes and
*no* pooled estimate; `exclude_deviated` counts excluded runs beside.
Per-arm `outcome_counts` stratify `infrastructure_failure` — the
`fail_fast` outage rows. `check_reroute_order` enforces the
`failed → (compacted →) relowered → rerouted → started` ordering with a
typed `RerouteOrderError`.

**The profile test battery gates linking.** `hh-compiler::profile_test`
runs V1–V9 (schema, golden surfaces, capability consistency, probe
verdicts, …) producing the versioned content-addressed
`ProfileTestReport`; `link` refuses a bound profile without a passing
report (`ProfileUntested`/`ProfileInvalid`) and a rule depending on a
`DRIFT`/`UNSUPPORTED` capability without recorded intent
(`CapabilityDrift`). The kernel `null` profile is exempt — compiling
under it is the compiler's own removal test. `fallback_used` records the
escape-hatch binding; `CompiledBundle.profile_test_report_ref` carries
the report; `test_reports` ride the wire `CompileInputs` so the OOP
`hh-compile` binary is byte-identical. `retire_rule` produces the
`P − R` profile, and `hh-eval::removal_verdict` returns
`pass | fail | inconclusive{reason}` — non-inferiority within the margin
*and* the reliably-regressed share within bound; a missing interval is
inconclusive, never a pass.

**K5 and the cache arm gates execute.** `hh-context::k5` is the
exact-match response cache: admissibility, the `served_from_cache`
terminal stamp, revocation withholding, dependency-stamp drift → stale,
one `k5.resolved` row per lookup. `ArmSpec.response_cache` is a closed
sum (`k5` only at C0); lab registration refuses a K5 arm on a
non-`reproduction` spec without a `cache` factor, a `natural` cache
policy on a `cache_state_visible = unsupported` dialect without
`cache_na_stratified`, and retirement arms outside
`{matched_cap, cold_start}` / not a single-rule removal diff.

**The GenAI export loses nothing silently.** `hh-telemetry::genai` lowers
model terminals to GenAI spans carrying
`gen_ai.usage.cache_read/write.input_tokens`; `model.cache.resolved` and
nonrepresentable members (`miss_reason`, `avoided.spend`, …) emit named
loss entries — nothing consumed without a projection or a named loss.

## Also in this change

- `hh-gateway` gains an `hh-registry` dependency (conformance records)
  — gateway → registry read view, plane-legal.
- The 13-shape golden corpus now runs × 2 wire dialects end-to-end,
  including the second dialect's cache path.

## Deferred

- **DF-S1.18-2 → DONE** — the Stage-3 model-plane executable battery is
  landed; every listed AC runs executable against the landed
  records/ports.
- **DF-S1.18-1 stays OPEN** — the emitter call sites on a real run (the
  Stage-2 turn-loop driver) and the live-transport/C1 halves are their
  own tickets' scope; this ticket lands the payloads, probes, and the
  ordering oracle they will call.
- Model-plane residuals predating the ticket (live streaming upgrades,
  TLS/cert admission) — unchanged.
